title: Mergeable Latency Histogram for p99
signature: class LatencyHistogram: __init__(alpha=0.01, max_buckets=2048), record(value_ms, count=1), merge(other), quantile(q), count(), buckets()
hints: Store a dict {bucket index: count} plus a separate counter for exact zeros. Index = ceil(log(v) / log(gamma)).
Percentiles do not average across replicas, but bucket counts add. merge() is a sum of counts and must not touch the other histogram.
Validate before mutating: a negative latency or a bad count raises without recording anything.
When there are too many buckets, fold the lowest ones upward. The tail is what your SLO is about.
